definition_zh: 虚张声势；逞强；故作勇敢
definition_en: a bold, confident manner pretended to impress or hide fear
core_image: 站在悬崖边上的年轻人故意笑得很大声，双腿却在发抖
scene: 夜里排队走独木桥时没人肯先认怯。His bravado vanished the moment the plank began to sway.
sceneCN: 这里 bravado 是「逞强、虚张声势」（第 1 个义项：假装出的大胆）；句意是独木桥一晃，他的逞强立刻消失了。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「勇敢的」
由同根加名词后缀构成，义为「勇敢（真实品质）」
由同根构成，义为「亡命徒；（喝彩）好」
由同根构成，义为「高超技艺的炫示」

senses.title: Pretended boldness
senses.definition: bold behavior assumed to hide fear or impress others
senses.definitionCN: 为掩饰恐惧或打动他人而装出的大胆言行
senses.example: His bravado hid a fear of heights.
senses.why: The root means brave; adding the Spanish-style ending makes the bravery a performance.
senses.whyCN: 词根义为「勇敢」，加上西班牙风词尾后，勇敢便成了一场表演。

senses.title: A show of defiance
senses.definition: an outward display of defiance toward an opponent or danger
senses.definitionCN: 面向对手或危险的外在挑衅姿态
senses.example: The rebels answered the decree with bravado.
senses.exampleCN: 叛军以示威姿态回应那道法令。
senses.why: Fear once masked turns outward as challenge.
senses.whyCN: 被掩盖的恐惧向外翻转为挑战。

senses.title: Rash courage in action
senses.definition: boldness that leads to needless risk-taking
senses.definitionCN: 导致不必要冒险的胆量
senses.example: He climbed the fence out of pure bravado.
senses.exampleCN: 他纯粹为了逞强翻过了围栏。
senses.why: A performance must be witnessed, so the risk is taken where eyes can see.
senses.whyCN: 表演必须有人看，于是冒险专挑有目光的地方。

senses.title: Loud swagger of speech
senses.definition: boastful, challenging talk without real intent
senses.definitionCN: 夸口叫阵、并无实际行动意图的言语
senses.example: Threats made in bravado are soon forgotten.
senses.exampleCN: 逞强时的狠话很快就被遗忘。
senses.why: The mouth is the easiest stage for a pretended self.
senses.whyCN: 嘴巴是表演假自我最便宜的舞台。

senses.title: Group spirit of defiance
senses.definition: a shared mood of boldness in a group facing danger
senses.definitionCN: 一群人面对危险时共同的逞强气氛
senses.example: The squad crossed the ridge in high bravado.
senses.exampleCN: 小队在一片逞强的亢奋中翻过山脊。
senses.why: When a whole group wears the same mask, the mask becomes the mood.
senses.whyCN: 当一群人戴同一种面具，面具就成了气氛。

senses.title: Spirit rewarded in stories
senses.definition: boldness celebrated as admirable daring in narrative
senses.definitionCN: 叙事中被当作可敬大胆来歌颂的胆气
senses.example: Old ballads turn bravado into glory.
senses.exampleCN: 古歌谣把逞强唱成荣耀。
senses.why: The line between acting brave and being brave blurs in legend.
senses.whyCN: 在传说里，「装勇敢」与「真勇敢」的界线本来就模糊。

senses.title: Confidence discovered in the act
senses.definition: courage that begins as pretense but carries the actor through
senses.definitionCN: 始于做作、却真正支撑人完成行动的胆量
senses.example: Half her bravado turned to real nerve halfway across.
senses.exampleCN: 走到一半，她的逞强有一半变成了真胆量。
senses.why: A mask worn long enough grows into the face.
senses.whyCN: 面具戴得够久，就长成了脸。

senses.title: Gallant flair, as of dress or style
senses.definition: in older use, showy gallantry in dress or manner
senses.definitionCN: 旧义指衣着举止上的华丽逞风流
senses.example: Earlier writers used bravado for a dashing style.
senses.exampleCN: 早期作家用 bravado 指潇洒张扬的做派。
senses.why: The Spanish brave gave both courage and finery, so the word once covered display of dress too.
senses.whyCN: 西班牙语的 brave 兼有「勇」与「俏」二义，故此词一度也指衣着上的张扬。

intro.en: Bravado came into English via French from Spanish bravada, built on bravo, brave.
intro.cn: bravado 经法语进入英语，源自西班牙语 bravada，词基为 bravo（勇敢的）。

items.en: The base is Latin barbarus or pravus by competing accounts; the Spanish word bravo meant brave, wild, or savage, with an uncertain deeper source.
items.cn: 词基的更早来源诸说不一（或谓拉丁语 barbarus，或谓 pravus）；西班牙语 bravo 意为勇敢的、狂野的，深层来源不确定。

items.en: Spanish bravo meant bold or defiant, and bravada meant a boastful, defiant act.
items.cn: 西班牙语 bravo 意为大胆、挑衅，bravada 意为逞强挑衅之举。

items.en: French borrowed the word as bravade, keeping the sense of defiant display.
items.cn: 法语借入该词作 bravade，保留挑衅性炫耀之义。

items.en: English took bravado from French bravade, reshaping the ending on the model of Portuguese and Spanish -ado words.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语借入 bravado，词尾按葡西语 -ado 类词的模式改造。

items.en: It flourished in tales of duels and soldiers, where pretended courage was a stock theme.
items.cn: 十七世纪盛行于决斗与军旅故事，假勇敢是那里的常见母题。

items.en: Modern use stresses the pretended quality; the older dress sense has fallen away.
items.cn: 现代用法强调「假装」性质；旧有的衣着义已消失。

note.en: Bravado belongs to the brave family; its Spanish-styled cousins describe displays of boldness of different kinds.
note.cn: bravado 属 brave 词族；其西语风格近亲们描写各色「大胆的展示」。

entries.definitionCN: 真正的勇气；与 bravado 的「假装」相对
精湛技艺的炫示；同根意语借词

entries.definition: a cry of approval, or a hired fighter

entries.definitionCN: 龙卷风；仅共用 -ado 词尾，词源不同
咆哮式空话；bravado 侧重姿态，bluster 侧重音量
伪装；bravado 是其勇敢版本
真胆量（口语），与 bravado 相对

normalIntro.en: See brave inside the word, wearing a Spanish costume: bravery in costume is bravado.
normalIntro.cn: 看见词里的 brave（勇敢）穿着西班牙戏服：穿上戏服的勇敢就是 bravado。

normal.en: brave is the root; -ado is the Spanish-style ending.
normal.cn: 词根是 brave；-ado 是西班牙风词尾。

normal.en: Spanish bravada means a defiant show.
normal.cn: 西班牙语 bravada 意为挑衅性的炫耀。

normal.en: armada and bravado share the -ado pattern of borrowing.
normal.cn: armada 与 bravado 共享 -ado 借词模式。

normal.en: bravery is the real thing; bravado the display.
normal.cn: bravery 是真品质，bravado 是表演。

normal.en: the stress is on the second syllable: bra-VA-do.

abstract.en: A loud laugh at the cliff edge, knees shaking below it.
abstract.cn: 崖边的大笑，膝下却在打颤。

abstract.en: Courage as a costume, worn for the audience.
abstract.cn: 勇敢如戏服，为观众而穿。

abstract.en: The mask is loudest where the fear is deepest.

examples.en: What looked like calm was really bravado.
Teenage bravado made him take the dare without a helmet.
examples.cn: 少年逞强使他没戴头盔就应了那个挑战。

examples.en: Her bravado melted when the referee actually blew the whistle.
examples.cn: 裁判真的鸣哨时，她的逞强顿时化了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不惹我兜」——嘴上喊「不惹我？我兜着走！」，其实兜里空空：喊得越响越是 bravado。

root: 西班牙语词根 brav-（勇敢的、狂野的；更早来源不确定）+ 逞强名词后缀 -ada 构成 bravada，经法语 bravade 进入英语作 bravado。

sensesIntro.en: From pretended boldness the word spreads to defiant shows, rash risks, loud talk, group moods, and the courage pretense can grow into.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项由假装的胆量出发，扩展至挑衅姿态、莽撞冒险、叫嚣之词、集体气氛，及伪装能长成的真勇气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mask of courage worn over a shaking face
core.cn: 核心意象：扣在发抖的脸上的勇气面具

branches.en: the pretended self: bold face and louder mouth
branches.cn: 假自我：Bold 脸与更响的嘴

branches.en: defiance outward: one challenger or a whole squad
branches.cn: 向外的挑衅：一人叫阵或全员逞强

branches.en: the price: risks taken where eyes can see
branches.cn: 代价：专挑有目光处的冒险

branches.en: the song's version: bravado sung as glory
branches.cn: 歌谣版：逞强被唱成荣耀

branches.en: the endings: mask grows into face; courage into finery
branches.cn: 两种结局：面具长成脸，胆气化作风流

intro.en: A Romance formation: brave root plus the Spanish -ada display suffix, anglicized in form.
intro.cn: 罗曼语式构词：brave 词根加西班牙语表「炫耀之举」的后缀 -ada，再英语化成形。

latinIntro.en: The deeper Latin source of bravo is disputed; scholarship offers barbarus and pravus without a settled answer.
latinIntro.cn: bravo 的更深拉丁来源有争议；学界提出 barbarus 与 pravus 两种说法，尚无定论。

items.example: French bravade is the direct source
items.exampleCN: 法语 bravade 是直接来源
